id_routing.description: Interconnect may append bits to AxID to identify the originating master; slave-side ID_WIDTH > master-side ID_WIDTH
id_routing.compliance_note: Returning ID is the WIDER value; routing strips appended bits before returning to the master

fields.topology_type: Star-of-stars: end-devices communicate by RF with multiple transparent gateways, which bridge over IP to a central network server. End-devices are not bound to a single gateway; the server deduplicates uplinks and selects one gateway per downlink.

supported_topologies.name: Star-of-stars
supported_topologies.description: Many end-devices -> many gateways -> one network server.

supported_topologies.name: Single-gateway star
supported_topologies.description: Small private network with one gateway.

master_slave_role_summary.description: Battery-powered sensor/actuator running LoRa PHY + LoRaWAN MAC; initiates communication.
Transparent RF<->IP concentrator; relays frames; runs no MAC.
Frame dedup, MAC commands, ADR, FCnt/MIC checks, gateway selection for downlinks.
Handles the OTAA join and session-key derivation.

fields.interconnect_role: LoRaWAN is an LPWAN access network: end-devices reach the network server through any in-range gateway. The RF segment is LoRa CSS; the backhaul segment is IP. Reliability/security (MIC, FCnt, encryption) is end-to-end between the device and the network/application server.

ordering_guarantees.frame_sequence: Per-device frame counter (FCnt) orders frames and rejects replays.
ordering_guarantees.dedup: The network server deduplicates the same uplink received by multiple gateways.
ordering_guarantees.downlink: One server-selected gateway transmits each downlink.

device_classification.end_device_class_a: Mandatory; two RX windows after each uplink.
